bullets.text: Architected and built the backend from scratch using FastAPI in a serverless AWS Lambda setup (via Mangum)
bullets.impact: enabled scalable and cost-efficient infrastructure for an early-stage construction project management platform
bullets.metrics: serving ~50 users with 10–15 DAU

bullets.text: Designed RESTful APIs supporting multi-role workflows (admin, supervisor, client) for project tracking, expenses, daily logs, document management, transactions, and punch-list issue tracking
bullets.impact: enabled end-to-end digitization of construction project operations

bullets.text: Implemented secure authentication using phone-based OTP, JWT access tokens, and rotating refresh tokens
bullets.impact: ensured seamless session continuity and improved reliability of login flows
bullets.metrics: 24-hour token rotation with near-zero unintended session drops

bullets.text: Optimized PostgreSQL performance with indexing and query improvements, eliminating N+1 query patterns
bullets.impact: improved query efficiency and reduced backend response overhead

bullets.text: Designed direct-to-S3 file upload flow using pre-signed URLs to bypass backend as a data proxy
bullets.impact: reduced server load, avoided redundant data transfer, and improved upload efficiency
bullets.metrics: eliminated double network hop for file uploads

bullets.text: Diagnosed and fixed a critical token refresh flow issue affecting frontend-backend integration
bullets.impact: resolved persistent user logout problems and stabilized authentication experience
bullets.metrics: reduced session failures to near-zero

bullets.text: Implemented per-user API rate limiting and enforced stateless architecture for serverless constraints
bullets.impact: improved system resilience and mitigated abuse under unpredictable traffic patterns
bullets.metrics: capped at 5 requests/second per user

bullets.text: Evaluated and implemented serverless infrastructure over EC2, handling tradeoffs like statelessness and VPC networking constraints
bullets.impact: reduced idle infrastructure cost while enabling automatic scaling

bullets.text: Shipped the customer-facing React Native mobile app to general availability on both the iOS App Store and Google Play, including a scripted version-bump and release process
bullets.impact: took the product from internal builds to a publicly installable app on both stores
bullets.metrics: 259 pull requests merged into the mobile codebase and 156 into the backend

bullets.text: Built subscription and billing flows, an organization invite system, transaction tracking, and CSV expense exports
bullets.impact: closed the loop from project tracking to monetization and back-office reporting

bullets.text: Resolved platform-specific mobile defects including iOS date picker incompatibility, submit buttons hidden behind the keyboard, and a fragmented file-picker flow consolidated into a single action sheet
bullets.impact: removed the friction points blocking iOS users from completing core data-entry tasks

bullets.text: Implemented the in-app account deletion request flow required for App Store compliance
bullets.impact: unblocked store review and satisfied platform data-rights obligations

bullets.text: Led a typed-API-boundary refactor of the React Native codebase: typed navigators, contexts, services, and every feature's API calls, split the monolithic Redux slices and upload service into modules, removed an import cycle, and made no-explicit-any a lint error
bullets.impact: turned an untyped data layer into a compiler-checked one and made the large slice files reviewable
bullets.metrics: 40 refactor pull requests, zero any in app code

bullets.text: Made money creates retry-safe end to end: the backend accepts client-generated IDs for expenses and transactions and the app retries with them, alongside fixes for create replies without an ID, retry credentials after network errors, and expense page retries
bullets.impact: stopped flaky site connectivity from producing duplicate expenses or transactions

bullets.text: Hardened authentication and upload reliability: moved the refresh token into Keychain/Keystore, revoked refresh tokens and cancelled in-flight uploads on sign-out, decoded base64url JWT segments correctly, kept undelivered attachments retryable, validated stored objects on upload confirmation, and serialized attachment cleanup with confirmation
bullets.impact: closed credential-at-rest and orphaned-upload gaps while keeping field users' photos from being lost on poor networks

bullets.text: Upgraded the app from Expo SDK 54 through SDK 58 (React Native 0.88.1, Android API 36) and added CI that builds the Android release and smoke-launches it on an emulator for every PR
bullets.impact: kept the app on a supported platform and caught release-build and launch failures before merge

bullets.text: Developed backend services using Django for a student career counseling platform
bullets.impact: enabled structured processing of academic and behavioral data for student insights

bullets.text: Designed and implemented APIs to compute student performance metrics and predict future grades using heuristic-based logic
bullets.impact: enabled data-driven evaluation and personalized academic guidance

bullets.text: Built a quiz and assessment system evaluating aptitude across domains (math, reasoning, vocabulary) and mapping results to personality-based career insights
bullets.impact: enabled personalized career recommendations and counseling workflows
bullets.metrics: supported multi-section assessments with dynamic scoring

bullets.text: Implemented pagination and filtering across APIs to improve data access patterns and response efficiency
bullets.impact: enhanced scalability and usability of API endpoints

bullets.text: Debugged and reconfigured Nginx reverse proxy to correctly route traffic across multiple subdomains and services
bullets.impact: resolved deployment conflicts and restored backend accessibility

bullets.text: Cleaned up legacy deployments and restructured backend/frontend hosting on Azure VM
bullets.impact: stabilized deployment environment and reduced routing inconsistencies

bullets.text: Built a webhook-driven CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and custom VM scripts for automated deployments
bullets.impact: enabled secure, automated deployments without direct SSH access
bullets.metrics: triggered on every push to main branch

bullets.text: Built a session-centric realtime dine-in platform in Go where a table QR code opens a live session that multiple guests and staff collaborate on simultaneously
bullets.impact: models the actual unit of restaurant work (the table) rather than forcing a user-centric account model onto it
bullets.metrics: 195 commits across 551 files in the release candidate

bullets.text: Designed a WebSocket hub with per-session room fan-out backed by Redis pub/sub, so order and presence events reach every client on a table without polling
bullets.impact: keeps guest and kitchen views consistent in real time across independent server processes

bullets.text: Implemented idempotent order placement with transactional price snapshots and deferred foreign-key constraints to resolve the circular session/host-participant reference
bullets.impact: guarantees exactly-once order semantics under client retries and flaky mobile networks

bullets.text: Enforced multi-tenant isolation so cross-branch and cross-organization access is rejected independently of the rollout feature flag, with route-level branch guards as defense in depth
bullets.impact: treats tenant scope violations as never-legitimate traffic instead of something a staged rollout could learn from
bullets.metrics: closed an independent security review

bullets.text: Instrumented the service with Prometheus metrics, structured zerolog output, health and readiness probes, and OpenTelemetry-based tracing
bullets.impact: made request flow and background worker behaviour observable before first production deployment

bullets.text: Made OpenAPI the single source of truth for the frontend contract, regenerating the spec from the actual handler and sqlc response types and adding CI checks that diff gin.Engine.Routes() against the spec in both directions and fail on generated-type drift
bullets.impact: turned a hand-maintained spec that silently disagreed with the server into a checked contract the frontend compiles against
bullets.metrics: surfaced 6 undocumented or missing routes plus money-type, nullability, and field-omission drift across 9 schemas

bullets.text: Building a platform for procedurally generated logic puzzles whose launch game is Queens, served from an offline-generated Catalog where a puzzle is admitted only if it has exactly one solution reachable through named human deductions, with a Daily Challenge, Streaks, and graded Hints
bullets.impact: keeps generation off the request path and guarantees every served puzzle is solvable by reasoning rather than guessing
bullets.metrics: 127 commits and 24 merged pull requests in under three weeks

bullets.text: Kept the solution server-side: the solution-bearing payload never leaves the API, the server recognises a solve rather than trusting a client assertion, and hints reveal the engine's next sound deduction in graded steps from technique to placement
bullets.impact: removes the answer from the client and makes hints teach the deduction instead of leaking the cell

bullets.text: Designed identity and data-rights flows around privacy: session-scoped guests, players minted on first completion behind an HttpOnly cookie, reversible merges on credential collision, and guarded erasure with read-only previews and deletion gated on re-proving identity with Google
bullets.impact: treats deletion and retention as designed behaviour before launch rather than a retrofit

bullets.text: Instrumented with OpenTelemetry to self-hosted SigNoz and enforced a no-identifier rule mechanically, with an attribute allowlist, collector-config and span-attribute checks, and rejection of span link attributes
bullets.impact: keeps player and attempt identifiers out of every span, log, and metric by construction instead of by convention

bullets.text: Built the production-readiness path: an explicit migration runner with separated database roles, liveness and readiness probes for the deploy gate, a locked non-root API image, and a monitor for the Daily Challenge runway
bullets.impact: separates schema changes from runtime privileges and gates deploys on real readiness

bullets.text: Built a production-style Write-Ahead Log (WAL) engine in Go with segmented append-only storage, CRC32C corruption detection, deterministic crash recovery, and checkpoint-assisted replay
bullets.impact: demonstrates database durability internals similar to PostgreSQL WAL and LevelDB/RocksDB logging subsystems
bullets.metrics: sustained ~1M replayed records/sec with deterministic recovery guarantees

bullets.text: Designed a concurrent group-commit architecture using a bounded write queue and single writer goroutine with configurable sync, batch, and async durability modes
bullets.impact: amortizes fsync overhead across concurrent writers while preserving strict LSN ordering guarantees
bullets.metrics: achieved ~9.8K writes/sec in batch mode with 100 concurrent writers

bullets.text: Implemented crash-consistency and corruption handling features including replay modes, manifest reconciliation, atomic checkpoints, partial-write detection, and fault-injection testing
bullets.impact: ensures prefix-consistent recovery behavior under truncation, corruption, ENOSPC, and interrupted flush scenarios
bullets.metrics: validated across 90+ tests including fuzzing, chaos injection, idempotency, and race-safe concurrency testing

bullets.text: Benchmarked durability and replay tradeoffs across sync policies, concurrent writer scaling, checkpoint-assisted recovery, and segment rotation workloads
bullets.impact: identified fsync latency and flush interval behavior as primary throughput bottlenecks while validating near-linear group-commit scaling
bullets.metrics: reduced recovery time by ~2.5x using checkpoint-assisted replay

bullets.text: Built operational tooling including WAL inspection, integrity verification, corruption visualization, Prometheus metrics, benchmarking suites, and graceful shutdown handling
bullets.impact: provides production-style observability and debugging capabilities for storage-engine behavior under stress and failure
bullets.metrics: exposed 13 Prometheus metrics and verified correctness under randomized chaos and recovery loops

bullets.text: Built a distributed job queue system with priority scheduling, retry-aware execution, and idempotent request handling
bullets.impact: ensures reliable asynchronous processing under concurrent load and failure scenarios
bullets.metrics: validated across ~295k requests with 0 API-level errors

bullets.text: Designed a multi-queue Redis scheduling architecture using FIFO, priority, and delayed retry queues
bullets.impact: supports deterministic job ordering, exponential backoff retries, and fair scheduling behavior
bullets.metrics: sustained ~153 req/s during breakpoint testing at 200 VUs

bullets.text: Implemented worker recovery, cancellation handling, execution timeouts, and per-job execution logging
bullets.impact: improves fault tolerance and observability during crashes and long-running task execution
bullets.metrics: recovered stuck processing jobs automatically on worker startup

bullets.text: Added a full observability stack with OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, Loki logs, and Tempo traces, shipped as a GHCR image via an init container
bullets.impact: made queue depth, worker throughput, and per-job latency directly measurable rather than inferred

bullets.text: Conducted extensive k6 stress testing to analyze latency, throughput, queue growth, and bottleneck behavior
bullets.impact: identified worker throughput as the primary scaling constraint while validating API and database stability
bullets.metrics: queue depth grew to ~26k jobs under ~100 creates/sec ingress during worker stress testing

bullets.text: Built and deployed the system using Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and an Oracle ARM64 VM behind Nginx and Cloudflare
bullets.impact: enabled automated deployments and reproducible infrastructure setup
bullets.metrics: deployed API, worker, PostgreSQL, and Redis as containerized services

bullets.text: Packaged the backend for a local single-node Kubernetes (kind) cluster using Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and Secrets
bullets.impact: demonstrates working knowledge of core Kubernetes primitives and pod-to-pod service discovery via cluster DNS

bullets.text: Built a real-time collaborative canvas using WebSockets and CRDT-based state synchronization (Yjs), shared by URL with no auth or database
bullets.impact: enables conflict-free multi-user editing without centralized locking

bullets.text: Designed a binary WebSocket protocol with room-based fan-out using uWebSockets.js for efficient message distribution
bullets.impact: supports high-frequency real-time updates with minimal overhead
bullets.metrics: handles ~140 messages/sec under load

bullets.text: Conducted load testing using k6 to evaluate connection scalability and system behavior under stress
bullets.impact: identified stable operating range and validated graceful degradation characteristics
bullets.metrics: stable up to ~150 concurrent users; tested up to 300 users

bullets.text: Analyzed latency distribution (p95, max) and connection behavior to diagnose queueing under high concurrency
bullets.impact: revealed event-loop and connection handling bottlenecks without system failure
bullets.metrics: p95 latency ~460ms at 150 users; ~17s at 300 users

bullets.text: Architected system to degrade gracefully under load instead of failing, maintaining connection integrity
bullets.impact: ensures reliability and predictability under stress conditions
bullets.metrics: 100% connection success rate with no dropped sessions

bullets.text: Built a FastAPI service that collapses messy, mutually conflicting records into a single reconciled profile per entity
bullets.impact: turns unreliable multi-source input into one grounded record downstream systems can trust

bullets.text: Derived an unresolved-issue flag from a model output but gated it on verification against the underlying source note before trusting it
bullets.impact: prevents unverified model output from propagating into reconciled data

bullets.text: Built a static-first portfolio with Astro, React, and Three.js under a deliberate subtraction-over-addition design constraint
bullets.impact: communicates technical depth without sacrificing load performance

bullets.text: Structured content around system design decisions, tradeoffs, and real engineering problems rather than feature lists
bullets.impact: improves positioning for technical reviewers who care about reasoning over surface

bullets.text: Write technical essays on system design, performance engineering, and real-world debugging, including three long-form build series that take the WAL engine, job queue, and collaborative canvas apart decision by decision
bullets.impact: demonstrates structured thinking and deep understanding of engineering tradeoffs
bullets.metrics: 38 posts, including three 10-part series

bullets.text: Built the site as a writing-first static blog on Astro with no CSS framework, optimized for durability over churn
bullets.impact: keeps the publishing surface maintainable with near-zero dependency drift

openSource.description: Free, lightweight local emulator for AWS services, ~31k GitHub stars

bullets.text: Implemented ECS ephemeral task volumes, backing each name-only or empty-host volume with a task-owned Docker volume shared across the task's containers, honouring read-only mounts, and cleaning storage up across failed launches, stops, natural exits, and restarts via labelled reconciliation
bullets.impact: let containers in the same ECS task share files, which the emulator had previously accepted but silently skipped
bullets.metrics: 1,064 lines across 16 files

bullets.text: Fixed ECS services created with a capacity provider strategy never launching tasks, by computing per-provider targets from the base/weight distribution and filling each provider's deficit for the current deployment
bullets.impact: made mixed FARGATE/FARGATE_SPOT services start, scale, and replace tasks correctly; verified end to end with the AWS Java SDK ServicesStable waiter
bullets.metrics: 274 lines across 5 files

bullets.text: Added x-amz-mp-object-size validation to S3 CompleteMultipartUpload, checked under the multipart lock before assembly, with InvalidRequest errors for mismatched, malformed, overflowing, and negative sizes
bullets.impact: brought the emulator in line with AWS, which rejects uploads whose parts don't sum to the declared size, instead of storing truncated objects
bullets.metrics: 240 lines across 6 files

bullets.text: Fixed the ELBv2 load balancer collapsing repeated target response headers to their last value, sharing one header-copy path between HTTP and WebSocket upgrade responses
bullets.impact: restored responses that set multiple cookies through the ALB

bullets.text: Fixed CloudWatch PutMetricData silently dropping datums nested under EntityMetricData, the shape the CloudWatch Agent sends, across the Query, JSON 1.0, and CBOR protocol paths; followed up by rejecting datums without a MetricName with AWS-compatible MissingParameter errors, validating every datum before any is stored
bullets.impact: made CloudWatch Agent metrics such as mem_used_percent and disk_used_percent actually appear in ListMetrics and GetMetricStatistics
bullets.metrics: 2 PRs, 613 lines across 14 files

bullets.text: Fixed the Cognito SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA challenge to return USER_ID_FOR_SRP and FRIENDLY_DEVICE_NAME as AWS does, through one shared challenge builder used by every auth flow that issues it
bullets.impact: let clients build the USERNAME and SECRET_HASH needed to answer the MFA challenge, which they previously could not
bullets.metrics: 388 lines across 9 files

bullets.text: Added MaxResults/Limit and NextToken pagination to SQS ListQueues and EventBridge ListRules, built on the shared cursor-based paginator so pages stay stable while resources are created and deleted, with AWS-shaped errors for invalid limits and tokens
bullets.impact: matched the AWS page-size caps and token semantics, so SDK paginators and clients with large numbers of queues or rules see complete, consistent listings
bullets.metrics: 2 PRs, 715 lines across 13 files

bullets.text: Made DynamoDB Query read only the requested partition's key range instead of visiting every item in the table, and stopped copying the whole table on every write in memory mode by keeping the live item map by reference for in-memory stores while durable modes still get a snapshot
bullets.impact: made query and write cost track partition size rather than table size, as on AWS, with responses unchanged
bullets.metrics: 2 PRs, 288 lines across 6 files; a 20-item partition query in a 100,000-item table fell from 21.7 ms to 1.4 ms, and PutItem p50 at 100,000 items from 14.7 ms to 1.4 ms

bullets.text: Implemented Cognito AdminListUserAuthEvents for Plus pools with threat protection, recording password and SRP sign-ins through new-password and MFA challenges, returning events newest first with MaxResults/NextToken pagination, keying history by user sub so a recreated username never inherits the old history, and following up by rejecting fractional, overflowing, and wrongly typed MaxResults values in this and the WebAuthn listing
bullets.impact: replaced an UnsupportedOperation error with the AWS-shaped operation that admin tooling calls, verified against the AWS Java SDK v2
bullets.metrics: 2 PRs, 1,417 lines across 12 files; 21 new tests, with the broader Cognito suite (1,697 tests) passing

bullets.text: Fixed two account- and region-fidelity gaps: Bedrock AgentCore tag calls answered ResourceNotFound in any non-default account because the ARN was checked against the default account rather than the request's, and RDS never returned HostedZoneId on clusters or instance endpoints, adding a generated per-region fact with a us-east-1 fallback
bullets.impact: restored tagging for non-default accounts while keeping tags isolated per account, and let Terraform's aws_rds_cluster.hosted_zone_id and Route 53 alias records pointing at RDS endpoints work
bullets.metrics: 2 PRs, 217 lines across 13 files

bullets.impact: expands mypy coverage in a codebase that boots instances on every major cloud provider
bullets.metrics: 7 typing PRs merged

bullets.text: Fixed isort configuration to skip gitignored files, removing spurious lint failures from local and CI runs
bullets.impact: reduced developer friction in the pre-commit workflow

bullets.text: Fixed the default-user unlock path wiping a user-supplied password hash: when sssd was installed but unconfigured, passwd -u succeeded while shadow's sss_cache call wrote unrelated output to stderr, and any stderr was treated as a refused unlock on an empty password, triggering passwd -d. The fallback now runs only when the shadow file confirms the password is really empty
bullets.impact: preserved hashed_passwd values that were being silently erased on affected images, without changing the existing empty-password unlock behaviour
bullets.metrics: 51 lines across 2 files
